newsitem.title: CANADA: Cara says fiscal 1997 dividend up 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cara says fiscal 1997 dividend up 11 pct.

text.p: Cara Operations Ltd said on Friday it declared a dividend of C$0.05 per share, payable on February 7 to shareholders of record of common and non-voting class A shares at the close of business January 28.

"The payment of the dividend declared today, when added to the C$0.05 dividend paid in June of 1996, results in a total dividend for the current fiscal year of C$0.10 per share. This represents an increase of 11 percent over the dividend of C$0.09 per share paid for the fiscal year ended in March 1996," Cara chairman and chief executive M.B. Byron said in a statement.

Cara said it will report results for its third quarter ending December 8 on February 6. This will allow Cara to include its proportionate share of The Second Cup's second quarter financial results, due out February 5.
Cara owns roughly 35 percent of Second Cup.
